title: Glowing teddy bear
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9b0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bodyG' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcf6e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c98a2a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='headG' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd98a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4952f'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='24' r='10' fill='#c98a2a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='24' r='5.5' fill='#ffb0c8'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='10' fill='#c98a2a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='5.5' fill='#ffb0c8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='url(#bodyG)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#ffe0a0'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='66' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#d4952f' transform='rotate(-20 22 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='66' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#d4952f' transform='rotate(20 78 66)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6.5' fill='#c98a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6.5' fill='#c98a2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ffb0c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ffb0c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='24' fill='url(#headG)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#ffe0a0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#7a4a8a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 51 Q50 56 56 51' stroke='#8a5a2a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='3.4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='3.4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff3c0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#fff3c0'/>
  <!-- cheek glow -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='47' r='3' fill='#ff9dbb' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='47' r='3' fill='#ff9dbb' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
